songs.songTitle: O Wow O Wow (How Wonderful She Is)
songs.line: I guess that's how we'd make up songs
stanza: Do you remember we used to really, really have fun?
'Cause we'd be just by ourselves, mucking around, really relaxed, not under pre…
I guess that's how we'd make up songs
I, I remember we were in bed and then we imagined somebody upstairs
I don't even know if we heard footsteps or imagined footsteps and then imagined…
That was in that little place opposite Brixton Prison
I didn't even realise that everyone wasn't like that
We tried to write a contract of love, but we only got as far as doing the border
There was never any words in it, which I thought said a lot more than anything…
